description.zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The application ID. It is created and queried in the console. Only a single ID can be passed in.

description.zh: 频道ID。仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The channel ID. Only a single ID can be passed in.

description.zh:
视频的裁剪方式。取值：

- **1**：保持比例裁剪。
- **2**：保持比例留边（默认值）。
description.en:
The video cropping mode. Valid values:

- **1**: Crop while maintaining the aspect ratio.
- **2**: Add borders while maintaining the aspect ratio (default).

description.zh: 布局ID组。
description.en: The layout ID group.

description.zh: 编码选项，请参见下文中的MediaEncode枚举值。
description.en: The encoding option. See the MediaEncode enumeration values below.

description.zh:
录制模式，取值：

- **0**：单流录制，不允许中间修改任务参数（不允许调用UpdateRecordTask接口修改任务参数）。
- **1**（默认值）：合流录制，支持多画面合流输出。

> - 单流录制模式下有效参数：StreamType、SourceType。
- 合流录制模式下有效参数：TaskProfile、MediaEncode、LayoutIds、BackgroundColor、SubSpecUsers、CropMode、UserPanes、Backgrounds、Watermarks、ClockWidgets。
description.en:
The recording mode. Valid values:

- **0**: Single-stream recording. The task parameters cannot be modified in the middle of recording (the UpdateRecordTask operation cannot be called to modify the task parameters).
- **1** (default): Mixed-stream recording. Multi-pane mixed-stream output is supported.

> - Valid parameters in single-stream recording mode: StreamType and SourceType.
- Valid parameters in mixed-stream recording mode: TaskProfile, MediaEncode, LayoutIds, BackgroundColor, SubSpecUsers, CropMode, UserPanes, Backgrounds, Watermarks, and ClockWidgets.

description.zh:
单流录制模式下视频源，取值：

- **camera**：摄像头。
- **shareScreen**：屏幕共享。

> 如果视频源为shareScreen，且仅推摄像头流，则录制摄像头流；如果同时推屏幕共享流，则录制屏幕共享流。
description.en:
The video source in single-stream recording mode. Valid values:

- **camera**: The camera.
- **shareScreen**: The screen sharing.

> If the video source is shareScreen and only the camera stream is pushed, the camera stream is recorded. If the screen-sharing stream is also pushed, the screen-sharing stream is recorded.

description.zh:
单流录制模式，取值：

- **0**（默认值）：录制原始流。
- **1**：仅录制音频流。
description.en:
The single-stream recording mode. Valid values:

- **0** (default): Record the original stream.
- **1**: Record only the audio stream.

description.zh: 指定订阅房间里有哪些用户音频流。
description.en: Specifies the audio streams of which users in the room to subscribe to.

description.zh: 指定订阅房间里有哪些用户摄像头流。
description.en: Specifies the camera streams of which users in the room to subscribe to.

description.zh: 指定订阅房间里有哪些用户屏幕共享流。
description.en: Specifies the screen-sharing streams of which users in the room to subscribe to.

description.zh: 指定该任务订阅的用户列表。
description.en: Specifies the list of users to which this task is subscribed.

description.zh: 任务ID。仅支持传单个ID，需保证唯一。由1~55位大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成。
description.en: The task ID. Only a single ID can be passed in. It must be unique. It consists of 1 to 55 characters, including uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
任务计费配置，根据您的不同设置，进行收费。请参见下文中的TaskProfile枚举值。

> - 编码选项MediaEncode的分辨率需要小于等于TaskProfile的分辨率。
- 布局最大窗格数需要小于等于TaskProfile的输入路数。
description.en:
The task billing configuration. Fees are charged based on your different settings. See the TaskProfile enumeration values below.

> - The resolution of the encoding option MediaEncode must be less than or equal to the resolution of TaskProfile.
- The maximum number of layout panes must be less than or equal to the number of input streams of TaskProfile.

description.zh: 配置模板ID。获取模板ID，请参见[AddRecordTemplate](~~193625~~)。
description.en: The configuration template ID. To obtain the template ID, see [AddRecordTemplate](~~193625~~).

description.zh: 指定非订阅房间里有哪些用户音频流。
description.en: Specifies the audio streams of which users in the room not to subscribe to.

description.zh: 指定非订阅房间里有哪些用户摄像头流。
description.en: Specifies the camera streams of which users in the room not to subscribe to.

description.zh: 指定非订阅房间里有哪些用户屏幕共享流。
description.en: Specifies the screen-sharing streams of which users in the room not to subscribe to.

description.zh: 布局参数列表。
description.en: The list of layout parameters.

description.zh: 当前布局的图片框位列表。
description.en: The list of image pane positions for the current layout.

description.zh:
窗格ID，取值：**0**~**15**。

> - 当指定的PaneId用户找不到的话，会默认显示其他的流，流的确定是根据用户加入频道的顺序。
- 如果某个UserPanes相关的参数为必选，则其他相关参数都为必选，反之都为非必选。
description.en:
The pane ID. Valid values: **0** to **15**.

> - If no user can be found for the specified PaneId, other streams are displayed by default. The streams are determined based on the order in which users join the channel.
- If a parameter related to UserPanes is required, all other related parameters are also required. Otherwise, none of them is required.

description.zh:
对应布局的用户视频输入。取值：

- **camera**（默认）：视频流。
- **shareScreen**：共享屏幕流。
description.en:
The user video input corresponding to the layout. Valid values:

- **camera** (default): The video stream.
- **shareScreen**: The screen-sharing stream.

description.zh: 当前布局的文字框位列表。
description.en: The list of text pane positions for the current layout.

description.zh: 对应布局框格的用户ID。N的取值：**1~16**。
description.en: The user ID corresponding to the layout pane. Valid values of N: **1 to 16**.

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明

- 调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[AddRecordTemplate](~~193625~~)添加录制配置模板。
<props="china">- 默认最多同时启动100个录制任务，超出后新的录制任务将不可用，如果有特殊需求，请[提交工单](https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/createIndex)。</props>
<props="intl">- 默认最多同时启动100个录制任务，超出后新的录制任务将不可用，如果有特殊需求，请[提交工单](https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/#/ticket/createIndex)。</props>

# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为500次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes

- Before calling this operation, you must have called [AddRecordTemplate](~~193625~~) to add a recording configuration template.
<props="china">- By default, up to 100 recording tasks can be started at the same time. After this limit is exceeded, new recording tasks become unavailable. If you have special requirements, [submit a ticket](https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/createIndex).</props>
<props="intl">- By default, up to 100 recording tasks can be started at the same time. After this limit is exceeded, new recording tasks become unavailable. If you have special requirements, [submit a ticket](https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/#/ticket/createIndex).</props>

# QPS limit
The per-user QPS limit for this operation is 500 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation properly. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~341645~~).
